# ghost/memory-game

Memo Game (Privacy Friendly, F-Droid): start a single-player game (difficulty 1-3), flip cards by row and column, try a pair, read pairs found, tries and time. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/memory-game
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/memory-game new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/memory-game flip_card --device <serial> --param row=<row> --param col=<col>
ghost skill run ghost/memory-game flip_pair --device <serial> --param first=<first> --param second=<second>
ghost skill run ghost/memory-game get_status --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a memory card game
- `flip_card`: Flip the card in row 1, column 2
- `flip_pair`: Flip the cards at row 1 column 1 and row 1 column 2
- `get_status`: How is my memory game going?
